title: Polynomial-time canonical stripping
statement: There are a finite Turing machine $M$ over the Boolean alphabet and a natural number $a$ such that, on every Boolean word $\alpha$, $M$ halts after $a(|\alpha|+1)^a$ steps with output equal to the word obtained by deleting all trailing ones from $\alpha$.
